answer: Attention-Delay Ledger. Each identity must post a continuously decrypted fable-style proof-of-work stream, advancing only by real elapsed compute; sessions pause if unread, and a random umber challenge demands a fresh chapter within minutes. Attackers must sustain parallel attention streams for every sybil, so cost scales linearly with fleet size — a hundred identities means a hundred concurrent, time-locked workers that cannot wander between tasks.
